title: Pre-bilattice
description: JSON Schema for a pre-bilattice as data: a finite carrier set together with four binary operation tables ⟨∧_t, ∨_t, ∧_k, ∨_k⟩. Each operation is required to define a lattice on the carrier; the lattice axioms are not expressible in JSON Schema and must be checked by a verifier.

carrier.description: The underlying set B as a finite array of distinct symbolic values.

truth-meet.description: ∧_t : B × B → B as a nested table; truth-meet[a][b] is a ∧_t b.
